The AWS guidelines recommend a monolithic database architecture, which 
should make IAM more manageable, and reduce costs (AWS, n.d.). Despite that, 
this projects author, decided that multiple databases would enable an easier 
developer experience. A microservices-oriented architecture, as mirrored by the 
database design, allows for greater flexibility during development.  
Finally, global secondary indexes were utilised aligning with the 
recommendations from (AWS, n.d.); enabling queries on the document, at a 
relatively inexpensive price, with significant benefits to request speeds. 
4.7 Holistic View of the Application’s Software 
Before delving into the intricacies of the software architecture, it is important to 
recognise some key design decisions. First is the use of callbacks, the android 
operating system does not allow for network calls to be made on the user 
interface thread (Android Devlopers, n.d.); therefore, to make changes to the 
user interface without blocking the thread callbacks have been utilised. Within 
the sequence diagrams below, the author illustrates the various responses from 
callback using alternate (alt) blocks.
